name: Becoming Captain - The Roguelike Deckbuilder
detailed_description:
Do you have what it takes to Become Captain?

Dive into Becoming Captain, a Roguelike Deckbuilder that challenge you to build your deck on the fly of every combat. Developed by Le Havre Creation, this indie gem offers mind bending card combat with endless replayability.

What to Expect

  • Master a Unique Battle System : Learn a unique card battle system to survive.

  • Face Dynamic Enemies: Face off against unique enemies with dynamic AI.

  • Feel the Mood: Enjoy a hand-crafted soundtrack that sets the mood.

  • Build Your Deck: Customize your deck with ever growing options.

Why Play Becoming Captain?

Whether you’re drawn to the thrill of uncovering hidden lore or the satisfaction of mastering challenging mechanics, Becoming Captain delivers an experience that’s equal parts mysterious and action packed. Perfect for fans of deckbuilders looking for something fresh.

Join the Crew:

Ready to grab the helm? Wishlist Becoming Captain now and follow Le Havre Creation for the latest updates as we sail toward launch!

Add Becoming Captain to your wishlist now and stay tuned for updates from our studio.

Experience a fresh twist on the classic card combat game genre. Engage in strategic battles where you must carefully plan how to utilize your arsenal to defeat your enemies. Whether it's wielding ordinary rocks found on the ground or unleashing the power of your reliable plasma rifle, every choice you make in combat will shape the outcome of the battle. Prepare yourself for a thrilling and innovative gameplay experience as you explore unconventional tactics and challenge your foes in unique ways.

Delve into the depths of the Calamity and uncover its origins. Discover the enigmatic "First folks" hidden within its depths. Navigate your way towards leadership and unravel the secrets of the empire and beyond. Embark on a journey to unearth the truth that lies within the heart of this mysterious world.

short_description: Dive into a unique Roguelike Deckbuilder experience with Becoming Captain, set in a sci-fi realm where piracy is nearly eradicated—except on the notorious Calamity. Will you become its captain or die trying?
